branches.summary: Exact adapter market census binds 0xfdfecf85a4dd90a7637ae2aaf28b35061166f0e62bfc714c565eed9f7e959783 to this oracle and the recorded collateral/LLTV. branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless Morpho liquidate checks the market oracle price and immutable LLTV, seizes collateral with the protocol incentive and requires loan-token repayment; actual transaction execution still depends on price-call success and liquidator funding.
branches.backstop: Reviewed Morpho liquidate has no protocol-funded insurance payment or mandatory external rescuer. No independent insurer or guaranteed liquidator capacity is established.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: When liquidation exhausts borrower collateral, residual borrow shares/assets are removed and badDebtAssets reduces that market totalSupplyAssets. Vault adapter realAssets then carries supplier losses into share NAV; there is no guaranteed par redemption.
